messages:
sam: Hey team :wave: I'm on-call tomorrow night (first time). Quick checklist? I want to avoid waking people up unnecessarily.

morgan: Congrats! :tada: High-level: PagerDuty ✅ Slack access ✅ VPN ✅ runbooks reviewed. Specifics below.

taylor: If you haven't, confirm PagerDuty login and test page:
```bash
pd login --api-token $PD_TOKEN
pd incidents test --service Redwood-API
```

devon: VPN: use corp-vpn (okta). Also make sure your SSH bastion key is uploaded to keybelt: https://redwood.internal/keybelt

oncall-bot: Rotation change: sam is scheduled 2026-04-02 00:00-08:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/rotations/infra

morgan: Read the postmortem/runbook for Redwood-API: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redwood-api/oncall
- Triage steps (first 10m)
- How to check model serving health
- Escalation matrix (pager -> pager + @morgan -> paging on-call-sre)

taylor: If it's a high-latency incident, check GPU memory pressure:
`kubectl -n serving top pod <pod> --containers`
Look for OOM or high load.

sam: Do we have an emergency Zoom? I don't want to ping people in DMs.

morgan: Yes — ZoomOps link is persistent. Join ZoomOps when an incident is P1. Meeting ID: 987-654-321. Also post a short incident summary in #incidents and pin the runbook link.

devon: Quick checklist for you:
1) PD test page ✅
2) Runbook read ✅
3) Join ZoomOps creds saved ✅
4) Notify mentor for shadow (taylor/morgan) :thumbsup:

taylor: I'll shadow with you for the first page — ping me on Slack and I'll join the ZoomOps call.

sam: Awesome, thanks. One last: any gotchas for timezones? I'm in PST.

morgan: Rotation times in the schedule are UTC. Use the iCal link to convert to your timezone. Also set phone fallback in PagerDuty if you're remote.

sam: Set phone fallback, added iCal, did PD test, skimmed runbook. Feeling better :relieved: 

oncall-bot: Test alert delivered to sam (success).

morgan: Great. If anything weird comes up, tag #eng-oncall and DM me. We'll do a 30-min post-rotation retro next week.

sam: Thanks everyone!
